newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Tech IPO limit-up, other IPOs fall.
newsitem.headline: Korea Tech IPO limit-up, other IPOs fall.

text.p: Shares of Korea Technology Banking Corp rose 1,200 won to a daily limit of 21,200 in the morning session of their first trading day on Tuesday, brokers said.
But they said six other initial public offerings fell sharply in thin trading.
Korea Technology is the nation's leading venture capital firm with the Ministry of Finance and Economy holding the biggest single stake of 10.2 percent.
Dongyang Mutual Savings and Finance Co fell 450 won to 7,050 and Daeyang Mutual Savings and Finance Co Ltd was down 1,100 won to 18,400.
Dong-A Mutual Savings and Finance Co and Seoul Mutual Savings and Finance Co each lost 600 won to 9,400, Hanmi Leasing Co shed 450 won to 7,050 and Hanil Leasing Co fell 510 won to 7,990.
But volume was low at between 200 to 5,000 shares.
"The listings were badly timed as the market has been languishing for a long time," said Koh Kyung-bae of Hyundai Securities.
Brokers said the Seoul stock market had been in the doldrums due to the pressure from huge margin loans and fears of a share oversupply.
